challenge.method: Check whether the neighboring description of SPITBOL changes which language the maintainer says SETL4 implements.
challenge.results: The SPITBOL discussion describes how the project extends its host. The naming passage explicitly identifies SETL as the implemented language. It provides no test of runtime behavior or current maintenance activity.

limitations: This is the maintainer's description of the named implementation at the pinned revision. Exact conformance, SPITBOL extensions, and executed behavior remain outside this identity claim.
